title: Favorite Mall World dream
content: There has been discussions of nightmares and bad mall dreams, but what are your favorite dreams and places from Mall World? I love hiking and in waking life, I'm too disabled to really do it much. I love when I get to go hiking. There is a desert ridge that I hike on, also up the canyon by the cabins I have gone hiking and camping. The vistas are always extremely beautiful. If I had to describe paradise, this would be it.
